about.title: About
about.paragraphOne: Knowledge-graph researcher and former enterprise architect with a background in enterprise digital transformation. Now building AI agent systems, with a focus on multi-agent organization and collaboration.
about.paragraphTwo: Model capability is only the starting point. Whether an agent system is reliable depends on how it calls tools, manages context, and handles failure, and on whether its output can be traced and verified.
about.backgroundBody: I began in knowledge-graph research, studying how knowledge can be represented and reasoned over in structured form. I later moved into enterprise architecture, working on the boundaries and coordination between business, data, and systems in the digital transformation of large enterprises. Both experiences shape how I approach agents: establish structure and boundaries first, then address capability and scale.
about.interestsBody: AI agent systems, in particular the organization and collaboration of multiple agents: how they divide work, share context, and resolve conflicts, and how the system as a whole can be governed and audited.
about.principleEvidenceBody: Judgments rest on real data, logs, and run results, not impressions.
about.principleClarityBody: Clearly separate verified facts, reasonable inferences, and what is not yet known.
about.principleUsefulBody: Research should result in work that is executable, traceable, and open to continued iteration.

aiMap.title: AI Industry Map
aiMap.description: A curated map in the format of CAICT's 2018 Global AI Industry Map, organized into four layers — applications, models, tools & platforms, and compute. Every number links to its source and verification date.
aiMap.disclaimer: A personal, curated view — not an authoritative ranking or investment advice.
aiMap.fallbackNotice: This page is available in Chinese and English.
aiMap.structureHint: Select a name for a short profile, key figures and sources.
aiMap.staleNote: Verified more than 45 days ago; waiting for the next update.
aiMap.hiddenNote: Verified more than 90 days ago, so the figure is hidden.

metrics.epochOwnedH100e: AI compute owned (H100-equivalents, incl. internal use)

aiMap.methodCriteria: Selection: at least one verifiable hard signal (an authoritative dataset, a financial filing or company disclosure, open-source activity); representative within its cell; releases or updates in the past six months; and a one-line description that does not overstate. Each cell has a China row and an elsewhere row, each with a cap — empty beats padded.
aiMap.methodData: Data: scheduled scripts collect from public sources (Hugging Face, GitHub, Epoch AI, SEC EDGAR, Wikidata); a few figures, such as quarterly revenue or fleet mileage, are checked by hand against the original announcement. Every number links to its source and verification date.
aiMap.methodCadence: Updates: collection runs on the 1st of each month and produces a change report that is reviewed before publishing. Figures verified more than 45 days ago are marked “update due”; after 90 days they are hidden.
aiMap.methodAi: Use of AI: one-line descriptions and category placement were drafted with AI assistance and reviewed by the maintainer; every number comes from a script or a manual check, never from AI.
aiMap.methodScope: Scope: regions follow the headquarters of the company or its parent; large tech companies are listed only for their AI businesses or products; no logos are used.
aiMap.methodCredit: Layout after the CAICT Global AI Industry Map (2018). Epoch AI data used under CC BY 4.0 (Epoch AI, Data on AI Models / AI Companies / AI Chip Sales / AI Chip Owners).

subscribe.title: Subscribe
subscribe.description: Follow the articles in an RSS reader. New posts show up there automatically, in full.
subscribe.step2: In your RSS reader, choose “Add feed” and paste it.
subscribe.step3: Every new article then appears in the reader on its own.
subscribe.whatIs: RSS is an update address a site keeps for its subscribers. Once you subscribe, new articles come to you, with no need to check back.
subscribe.agentIntro: Rather not install a reader? Copy the text below to the AI agent you already use, such as Claude, ChatGPT, Codex or OpenClaw, and let it subscribe for you.
subscribe.agentPrompt:
Please subscribe me to Shoa Lin's articles. Feed (RSS): {url}

1. If I use an RSS reader (such as Folo, Inoreader, Feedly or NetNewsWire) and you can operate it, add this feed there and tell me when it's done.
2. If I don't have a reader, or you can't operate it, follow the feed yourself: check it once a day, and when there's a new article, send me its title, link and two or three key points. Use each item's guid to tell new articles from old ones, and don't repeat any you've already told me about. On the first check, tell me only about the latest article.
3. Before you start, tell me which approach you'll take. Ask me first if you need me to sign in or grant access.
